description: Website Crawler. Website Crawler API fetches raw HTML from any webpage in request mode (no rendering) for fast scraping, audits, monitoring, and link/metadata extraction. Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

allow_redirects.description: If set to false, do not follow redirects. Default: true.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

query.description: A website URL with either the http or https protocol.

return_page_source.description: If set to true, the response will be the HTML source of the page. Default: false.

name: website_crawler
title: Website Crawler
